entries.name: Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer
entries.definition: A credential from the American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography for sonographers who perform ultrasound examinations of the heart.

entries.name: Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer
entries.definition: A credential from the American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography for sonographers who perform diagnostic ultrasound examinations.

entries.name: Registered Dietitian
entries.definition: A credential awarded by the Commission on Dietetic Registration to dietitians in the United States who have completed an accredited degree, supervised practice and an exam.

entries.name: Registered Health Information Administrator
entries.definition: A credential from AHIMA for health information managers who oversee patient records, health data and privacy.

entries.name: Registered Health Information Technician
entries.definition: A credential from AHIMA for technicians who code, maintain and check the quality of patient health records.

entries.name: Registered Phlebology Sonographer
entries.definition: A credential from the American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography for sonographers who perform ultrasound examinations of the veins.

entries.name: Registered Physician in Vascular Interpretation
entries.definition: A credential from the American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography for physicians who interpret vascular ultrasound studies; the tag names its exam.

entries.name: Registered Poetry Therapist
entries.definition: A credential for practitioners trained in using poetry and other literature as a form of therapy.

entries.name: Registered Respiratory Therapist
entries.definition: A credential from the National Board for Respiratory Care for respiratory therapists who pass its advanced-level exams.

entries.name: Registered Vascular Specialist
entries.definition: A credential from Cardiovascular Credentialing International for specialists who perform vascular ultrasound and other vascular testing.

entries.name: Registered Vascular Technologist
entries.definition: A credential from the American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography for technologists who perform vascular ultrasound examinations.

entries.name: Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit
entries.definition: A U.S. Federal Communications Commission permit that allows a person to operate certain radio equipment, such as aircraft and marine radios.

entries.name: SACA Certified Industry 4.0 Associate, Advanced Operations
entries.definition: A certification from the Smart Automation Certification Alliance for advanced operations in Industry 4.0 manufacturing environments.
variants: SACA Certified Industry 4.0 Associate Advanced Operations

entries.name: SACA Certified Industry 4.0 Associate, Basic Operations
entries.definition: A certification from the Smart Automation Certification Alliance for basic operations in Industry 4.0 manufacturing environments.
variants: SACA Certified Industry 4.0 Associate Basic Operations

entries.name: SACA Certified Industry 4.0 Associate, Robot System Operations
entries.definition: A certification from the Smart Automation Certification Alliance for operating robot systems in Industry 4.0 manufacturing environments.
variants: SACA Certified Industry 4.0 Associate Robot System Operations

entries.name: SACA Certified Industry 4.0 IIoT Net Data
entries.definition: A certification from the Smart Automation Certification Alliance covering networks and data in industrial internet of things systems.

entries.name: SAFe Release Train Engineer
entries.definition: A certification from Scaled Agile, Inc. for people who lead the planning and delivery of an agile release train in the Scaled Agile Framework.

entries.name: Safety Trained Supervisor
entries.definition: A safety credential for supervisors trained to manage workplace safety.

entries.name: Sailing certification
entries.definition: A certificate showing that a person has been trained and assessed in sailing skills, awarded by a sailing association or school.

entries.name: School bus endorsement
entries.definition: A commercial driver's licence endorsement, issued by a US state, that permits driving a school bus.

entries.name: Scissor lift certification
entries.definition: A certificate showing that a person has been trained to operate scissor lifts, aerial work platforms that raise straight up on a folding frame.

entries.name: Security Certified Network Architect
entries.definition: A certification from the Security Certified Program for designing secure network architectures.

entries.name: Security Check (SC) clearance
entries.definition: A UK government security clearance level that allows regular access to secret assets.

entries.name: Senior Certified Welding Inspector
entries.definition: An American Welding Society certification for experienced welding inspectors, ranking above the Certified Welding Inspector.

entries.name: Series 22 Direct Participation Programs Limited Representative
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for representatives who sell direct participation programs, such as limited partnerships.

entries.name: Series 24 General Securities Principal
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for principals who supervise a broker-dealer's general securities business.

entries.name: Series 26 Investment Company and Variable Contracts Products Principal
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for principals who supervise the sale of mutual funds and variable annuities.
variants: Series 26 Investment Company And Variable Contracts Products Principal License

entries.name: Series 27 Financial and Operations Principal
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for principals who supervise a broker-dealer's financial reporting and operations.
variants: Series 27 Financial And Operations Principal License

entries.name: Series 3 National Commodity Futures
entries.definition: A qualification exam, administered through FINRA for the National Futures Association, for people who sell futures and options on futures.

entries.name: Series 31 Futures Managed Funds
entries.definition: A qualification exam, administered through FINRA for the National Futures Association, for people who sell managed futures funds.

entries.name: Series 4 Registered Options Principal
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for principals who supervise a firm's options business.

entries.name: Series 52 Municipal Securities Representative
entries.definition: A qualification exam, written by the Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board and administered by FINRA, for representatives who sell municipal securities.

entries.name: Series 53 Municipal Securities Principal
entries.definition: A qualification exam, written by the Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board and administered by FINRA, for principals who supervise a firm's municipal securities business.

entries.name: Series 55 Equity Trader Limited Representative
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for traders of equity securities at broker-dealers.
variants: Series 55 Equity Trader : Limited Representative License

entries.name: Series 56 Proprietary Trader
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for traders who trade a firm's own capital in securities.

entries.name: Series 6 Investment Company and Variable Contracts Products Representative
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for representatives who sell mutual funds and variable annuities.
variants: Series 6 Investment Company And Variable Contracts License (Mutual Funds/Variable Annuities)

entries.name: Series 63 Uniform Securities Agent State Law
entries.definition: A state securities-law exam, written by the North American Securities Administrators Association, that most states require of people who sell securities.
variants: Series 63 Uniform Securities Agent State Law License

entries.name: Series 65 Uniform Investment Adviser Law
entries.definition: A state securities-law exam, written by the North American Securities Administrators Association, for people who give investment advice for a fee.
variants: Series 65 Uniform Registered Investment Adviser Law License (RIA)

entries.name: Series 66 Uniform Combined State Law
entries.definition: A state securities-law exam that combines the state-law content of the Series 63 and Series 65 exams, for people who work as both securities agents and investment adviser representatives.
variants: Series 66 Uniform Investment Adviser : Combined State Laws License (Combined 63 And 65)

entries.name: Series 7 General Securities Representative
entries.definition: A FINRA qualification exam and registration for representatives who sell most types of securities, such as stocks, bonds and mutual funds.
